nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner stored in Owned contract.
Pending owner address used by two-step ownership transfer.
Token symbol string, set to YBV in constructor.
Token name string (香港旭泰), set in constructor.
Token decimals, set to 2.
Total token supply, set to 100000000000 in constructor.
Mapping of holder address to token balance.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance.
Checked addition with overflow guard (c >= a).
Checked subtraction with underflow guard (b <= a).
Checked multiplication with overflow guard.
Checked division with division-by-zero guard.
Owned constructor: assigns msg.sender as owner.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner address.
Completes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner.
Token constructor: sets metadata, total supply and allocates all tokens to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns balance of a given token owner.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using SafeMath.
Sets allowance for a spender from msg.sender.
Transfers tokens on behalf of an owner using allowance of msg.sender.
Returns remaining allowance for spender on tokenOwner.
Sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval external function in the same transaction.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function calling transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 address.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and balance accounting.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after state update.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary contract.
Integer arithmetic operations protected by SafeMath guards (add, sub, mul, div).
Recipient address parameter 'to' of transfer.
Amount parameter 'tokens' of transfer.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter 'tokens' of approve.
Source address parameter 'from' of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter 'to' of transferFrom.
Amount parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom.
Spender contract address parameter of approveAndCall.
Allowance amount parameter of approveAndCall.
Arbitrary calldata 'data' forwarded to receiveApproval.
Candidate new owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Arbitrary ERC20 contract address parameter of transferAnyERC20Token.
Amount parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token.
Local result variable 'c' holding the output of SafeMath arithmetic.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Caller address msg.sender becomes the initial owner.
_newOwner parameter is written into newOwner.
Only the owner may stage a new owner via onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
acceptOwnership copies newOwner into owner.
Owner state variable is overwritten after caller authorization check.
newOwner is reset to address(0) after acceptance.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller controls the source balance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using caller as owner key.
transferFrom checks allowed[from][msg.sender], caller is the spender.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
Constructor writes the token symbol.
Constructor writes the token name.
Constructor writes the decimals value.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to 100000000000.
Constructor credits the entire supply to a hardcoded holder address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf returns an entry of the balances mapping.
transfer writes debited and credited entries in balances.
approve writes an allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom updates both source and destination balances.
transferFrom decreases the spender allowance in allowed.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
State (allowed mapping) is updated and then an arbitrary spender contract is called via receiveApproval, enabling reentrant behavior.
Owner-only rescue path performs an external call into an arbitrary ERC20 contract.
transfer uses safeSub for the sender balance debit.
transfer uses safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
safeAdd performs an addition that requires an overflow check.
safeSub performs a subtraction that requires an underflow check.
safeMul performs a multiplication that requires an overflow check.
safeDiv performs a division that requires a zero-divisor check.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
Recipient parameter drives the balance credit in transfer.
Amount parameter drives debit and credit amounts in transfer.
Spender parameter is used as the allowance key in approve.
Token amount parameter is stored as the allowance in approve.
Source parameter keys both balances and allowed in transferFrom.
Recipient parameter drives the balance credit in transferFrom.
Amount parameter drives debits and credit in transferFrom.
Spender address is both allowance key and external call target in approveAndCall.
Token amount is stored as allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
Arbitrary data bytes are forwarded to the spender callback.
Arbitrary token address is the target contract of the external transfer call.
Token amount parameter is passed to the external ERC20 transfer call.
Local variable c holds the arithmetic result subject to SafeMath guards.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' parameter only carries the recipient address into transfer's balance update and has no independent semantic identity.
The 'tokens' parameter only feeds SafeMath debit/credit inside transfer.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowed mapping key inside approve.
The amount parameter is only stored as the allowance value inside approve.
The 'from' parameter is only used to key balances and allowed inside transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is only used for the balance credit inside transferFrom.
The amount parameter is only used for SafeMath debit and credit inside transferFrom.
The spender parameter is used both as allowance key and as the external call target, so it is subsumed by approveAndCall.
The amount parameter is only stored as allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
The data blob is only forwarded verbatim to the spender callback and has no other use.
The candidate owner address is only assigned into newOwner within transferOwnership.
The token address is only the target of the single external transfer call.
The amount parameter is only forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
Local result variable c exists only to hold the output of the guarded arithmetic operations.
